en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate façade of a late‑19th‑century building with a large arched glass entrance and rich stucco decoration. An allegorical winged statue stands on the roof holding a laurel wreath. Above the central arch is a cartouche with the word "COLONNADE" and additional decorative text. On the right side of the façade a plaque bears the date "1879". People in late‑19th or very early‑20th‑century clothing stand and stroll in front of the entrance on a gently sloping street.
